그렇다.gloss: to be so, to do so

meanings.en: to be like that, to be so
meanings.note: ㅎ-irregular; also used as a pro-verb ('do so / say so')

examples.trans: Is that really so?
Don't keep acting like that.

meanings.note: Colloquial contraction of 그런데; introduces a contrast or obstacle.
Used to shift the topic in conversation.

examples.trans: By the way, what time is it now?
I want to go. But I don't have time.

나가다.gloss: to go out, to step outside

meanings.en: to go out, to step outside, to leave a room

examples.trans: Let's step outside for a moment and talk.
He went out of the conference room.
Has everyone been doing well?
Everyone, gather over here.
Let's meet next time.
The next station is Seoul Station.

examples.text: 이건 신디가 탄 거기 때문에 우리한테는 아무런 도의적 책임이 없다는 거야, 거기까진 맞지?
examples.trans: Since Cindy got in on her own, we bear zero moral responsibility—we agree up to there, right?
This point about moral, ethical is really important.

examples.text: 우리가 그런 사이는 아니지 않나? 잠수를 탈 때 도주로를 확보해 준다든지 은신처를 제공해 준다든지!
examples.trans: Are we really on terms like that—securing a getaway route or providing a hideout when you go AWOL?

examples.text: 와, 결국엔 내가 하고 말았어! 신디 잠수 타는데 도주로 확보해주고 은신처도 제공해주고!
examples.trans: Wow, in the end I actually went and did it—securing a getaway route and a hideout for Cindy!

examples.trans: I want to become a doctor.

meanings.note: Often used as a bound noun after -(으)ㄹ to mean 'when' or 'while'.

examples.trans: Call me when you have time.

meanings.note: Usually followed by -e to mean 'because of'.

examples.trans: I was late because of the rain.
It's because of you.

맞다.gloss: to be right, to be correct

meanings.note: Used to confirm facts or answers.

meanings.en: to fit, to suit, to match

examples.trans: Yes, that's my phone number.
These shoes fit my feet perfectly.
Do you have any wet wipes?
This point about wet wipes is really important.

meanings.note: colloquial contraction of 무엇; also used rhetorically to brush off a question

examples.trans: What are you doing now?
Why are you even asking something like that?

examples.trans: Producer Baek Seung-chan here is very sensitive about late fees and extra charges.

보다.gloss: to see, to watch; to take (an exam)

examples.trans: I watched a movie on the weekend.

meanings.note: Honorific noun and counter for people, used instead of 사람.

examples.trans: That person over there is our teacher.

빼다.gloss: to take out; to remove; to exclude

meanings.en: to take out; to remove; to exclude

examples.trans: Please take my name off the list.
